metadata.description: Codex and Cursor skill plugins for Python, TypeScript, Rust, Textual, task management, and agent orchestration.

plugins.name: python-scripting
plugins.description: Low-context guidance for safe one-off Python helpers, typed scripts, lightweight quality checks, and zero-dependency macOS utilities.

plugins.name: python-development
plugins.description: Deep Python production guidance for testing, project tooling, concurrency, and type-system work.

plugins.name: typescript-development
plugins.description: Deep TypeScript production guidance for testing, tooling, modules, packaging, and type-system work.

plugins.name: project-tasks
plugins.description: Capture tasks inline with task:/fix:/todo:/plan: prefixes, store in SQLite, group work under plans, dispatch to subagents, and auto-generate changelogs.

plugins.name: agent-team-development
plugins.description: End-to-end Agent Teams orchestration for cross-cutting work requiring inter-agent communication and worktree isolation.

plugins.name: orchestration-strategy
plugins.description: Evaluate multi-task workloads and select the most cost-efficient orchestration approach: solo, parallel, sequential, or Agent Teams.

plugins.name: rust-coding
plugins.description: Guide an AI coding assistant in writing idiomatic Rust with proper data modeling, traits, macros, and build-speed best practices.

plugins.name: textual
plugins.description: Reference skills for the Textual Python TUI framework — valid CSS properties and complete widget API with reactive attributes.
